q: How many leave days does someone get in their first year if they joined in July?
answer:
A July joiner gets **8 days**, granted on the first 1 January after joining. That is a prorated grant, calculated as 15 × (6 ÷ 12) = 7.5, rounded up to 8.

Before that grant arrives, they also accrue one day per completed month, so about 5 days (August through December) can be booked during the rest of the year. The monthly days are replaced by the 8-day grant, not added to it, and any unused monthly days lapse on 1 January. From the second 1 January on, they get the standard 15 days.

Sources: the annual leave document (`/v1/nodes/annual-leave/body`) and the mid-year joiner proration table (`/v1/nodes/proration-table/body`). I didn't find a conflict between them.
